description: Standard single call to a building with no interior scan (fake_quarry_depot). Expect the no-scan re-plan, exterior entries from aerial imagery, a gaps list, and low-confidence considerations held for dispatcher approval.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: 911, what's the address of your emergency?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: There's a fire at the warehouse at 48 Quarry Road, I can see flames through the side door.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I don't know, I can't see anybody. The alarm is going off.
